dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: One prominent closed circular annulus with a serrated perimeter in the left mid-lateral region; one large elongated 'O' shape along the dorsal ridge with a bright outer boundary; and a cluster of several overlapping, smaller 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the posterior-right lateral surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of high-intensity pixels forming a jagged, irregular boundary along the anterior-lateral edge; scattered low-density point-source pixels within the interiors of the larger annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the left mid-lateral annulus, the primary dorsal ridge annulus, and the center of the posterior-right cluster form an obtuse scalene triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: A continuous, highly irregular jagged line of high-intensity pixels extending from the anterior-ventral region toward the mid-lateral section, separate from the circular annuli.
